Can either be purchased from [[Royal services]] for {{Silver Coin}}50, or received from [[Snake]] at {{Happiness|30}}. The stamp allows creating {{Item|Package of meat}} which allows selling meat to [[Horadric]] and complete his quests.

After obtaining the Stamp, telling Horadric about it, and then inserting the Stamp in the [[Cooking table]], the recipe for packages of meat is unlocked.
